title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
title_zh: ProgramGym：为长期程序复现智能体构建可扩展的训练环境

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym , a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 1{,}648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87 % 34.87\% to 42.84 % 42.84\% . Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71 % 55.71\% and 56.25 % 56.25\% , both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.

paragraphs.en: Current coding agents ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026a ) typically handle issue-resolution tasks and repository generation tasks. Issue-resolution tasks such as SWE-bench give a repository and an issue for the agent to patch ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Rashid et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Repository generation tasks such as NL2Repo-Bench give a requirements document for the agent to implement ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . In both settings, the agent starts from a given codebase or a specified feature. A software engineer building a program from scratch instead keeps asking what is required and how the system should be designed.

paragraphs.en: To explore this from-scratch setting, program reproduction tasks such as ProgramBench ask an agent to rebuild a program’s observable behavior from its usage documentation and a reference program without access to the source code or network ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) . The agent needs to still discover remaining behavior by exploration and design the implementation from scratch. None of the models in the original ProgramBench evaluation fully solved a task ( Yang et al., 2026b ) 1 1 1 Release-time results; later performance of the flagship models are at https://programbench.com . . Training therefore requires interactive environments with reliable behavioral supervision, which issue-resolution resources such as SWE-Gym and SWE-smith do not provide ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Song et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . MindForge ( Chen et al., 2026b ) is restricted to command-line programs and still leaves this supervision unverifiable. Building verifiable environments and using them over long horizons raises two challenges. (i) Scaling verifiable training environments. Building the reference executable and runtime sandbox requires accommodating repository-specific toolchains and dependencies. The black-box tests need to cover diverse functionality while rejecting incorrect reproductions, yet a single test-generation attempt may miss important behaviors or produce weak assertions. (ii) Sustaining long-horizon development. General-purpose agent harnesses support tool use but do not by themselves keep exploration and implementation coordinated. An agent can begin implementing before sufficiently exploring the reference program and forget previously observed requirements as its context grows. Addressing these risks requires an explicit development workflow that preserves behavioral evidence and coordinates implementation, review, and revision.

paragraphs.en: To overcome these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env addresses environment construction by augmenting an existing agent harness with feedback-driven loops for runtime sandbox and black-box test construction. To produce the reference executable and its runtime sandbox, it separates online dependency preparation from offline compilation and returns build diagnostics to guide repairs. Test construction proceeds across functional modules in parallel, using program analysis to target unexplored behavior and validation feedback. The resulting environments provide reference executables, runtime sandboxes, documentation, and black-box behavioral test suites for training supervision. Program-Agent addresses long-horizon development through a role-isolated iterative workflow of analysis, implementation, and review. It first records evidence from reference-program exploration and then alternates implementation with behavioral review in separate sessions. Persistent records carry requirements across rounds, while offline build checks and validated checkpoints support revision and failure recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们提出了 ProgramGym，它由 Program-Env 和 Program-Agent 组成，用于构建可扩展的长期程序复现智能体的训练环境。 具体而言，Program-Env 通过为现有的智能体框架增加反馈驱动循环，实现运行时沙盒和黑盒测试的构建，从而解决环境构造问题。 为了生成参考可执行文件及其运行时沙盒，它将在线依赖准备与离线编译分离，并返回构建诊断信息以指导修复。 测试构建过程并行地针对各个功能模块进行，利用程序分析来定位未探索的行为和验证反馈。 由此生成的环境为训练监督提供了参考可执行文件、运行时沙盒、文档以及黑盒行为测试套件。 Program-Agent 通过一个角色隔离的迭代工作流程（包括分析、实现和审查）来处理长期开发任务。 它首先记录从参考程序探索中获得的证据，然后在独立的会话中交替进行实现与行为审查。 持久化的记录会在各轮次间传递需求，而离线构建检查和已验证的检查点则支持修订与故障恢复。

paragraphs.en: Training large language models as agents has gained substantial attention ( Team et al., 2026 ; Qwen et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , with software engineering (SWE) emerging as a promising application domain ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) . Issue resolution is a representative setting, in which SWE-bench tasks ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and its variants evaluate coding-agents on addressing bug fixes or feature requests within a given code base ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Ahmad et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; La et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Despite their growing diversity, issue resolution tasks depend on a provided code base, while several prior and concurrent works go further by asking agents to code from scratch according to a requirements document ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . However, this setting typically relies on a natural-language requirements document that prescribes the functional specification ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , reducing the task to implementation and leaving no room for requirement discovery or architectural design. In contrast, recent work on program reproduction from scratch requires agents to reconstruct the externally observable behavior of a reference program from a binary executable and documentation without prescribing implementation structure ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) . This setting therefore shifts the challenge from implementing a specified repository to iteratively discovering what the program should do and deciding how to rebuild it, as experienced software engineers.

paragraphs.en: Existing program reproduction from scratch remains highly challenging ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) . None of the flagship models in the original ProgramBench evaluation fully resolved any of the 200 tasks ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . Due to the scarcity of training environments for such tasks, coding agents tend to be trained as code-edit assistants that favor localized bug fixes or single-file implementations with detailed human guidance rather than as autonomous software engineers ( Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) . Providing realistic and executable training environments at scale is essential. This strategy is already proven in issue resolution ( Song et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , where generated environments improved SWE-agent performance ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) . These frameworks still start from an existing codebase or a well-specified task description. MindForge does not filter training trajectories by recovered program behavior, so functionally incorrect reproductions can still be treated as successful supervision ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . By contrast, ProgramGym makes program reproduction from scratch training scalable by automatically turning repositories into verifiable training environments. This increases sample sizes and converts coding agents from compliant code editors into active software engineers.
paragraphs.zh: 从头开始重现现有程序仍然极具挑战性（Yang et al., 2026b；Adamczewski et al., 2026）。 在原始的 ProgramBench 评估中，没有任何一个旗舰模型能够完全解决这 200 项任务中的任何一项（Yang et al., 2026b）。 由于此类任务的训练环境稀缺，编码智能体往往被训练为代码编辑助手，倾向于在详细的人类指导下进行局部错误修复或单文件实现，而非作为自主的软件工程师（Adamczewski et al., 2026）。 大规模提供真实且可执行的训练环境至关重要。 这一策略在问题修复领域已经得到验证（Song et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026a），其中生成的环境提升了 SWE-agent 的性能（Jain et al., 2025；Pan et al., 2024）。 这些框架仍然从现有的代码库或明确定义的任务描述出发。 MindForge 不会根据恢复的程序行为筛选训练轨迹，因此功能上错误的重现仍可能被视作成功的监督（Chen et al., 2026b）。 相比之下，ProgramGym 通过自动将代码仓库转化为可验证的训练环境，使从头开始重现程序的训练具备了可扩展性。 这增加了样本规模，并将编码智能体从顺从的代码编辑器转变为主动的软件工程师。

paragraphs.en: Here, ℰ \mathcal{E} denotes the collection of N N program-reproduction environments constructed by Φ \Phi . Each environment e i e_{i} comprises an execute-only reference program B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} built from P i P_{i} , its usage documentation D i D_{i} , a black-box behavioral test suite 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} , and a network-isolated runtime sandbox 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} in which the task agent operates. paragraphs.en: Constructing program-reproduction environments at scale requires reliable executable rebuild from diverse repositories and comprehensive black-box behavioral tests that broadly capture program functionality. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Program-Env , which uses general harnesses such as Claude Code and Codex and adds feedback loops to guide the overall process of build repair and test refinement. As illustrated in Figure 2 , Program-Env first collects candidate repositories { P i } i = 1 M \{P_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} (Section 4.1 ) and then constructs each retained environment e i e_{i} by building the reference executable and runtime sandbox (Section 4.2 ) and generating black-box tests (Section 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: To construct a diverse candidate pool of repositories for our program reproduction gym, Program-Env collects repositories through a stratified search process using the GitHub Search API. Specifically, we partition search queries by programming language and star-count buckets, while excluding archived and forked repositories. We further validate repository metadata, remove duplicate entries, and retain those with valid licensing metadata. Repositories already used by existing code-related benchmarks are also excluded. Each retained repository is anchored to a fixed commit and screened for explicit build-configuration evidence. This process yields M = 30,459 M{=}30{,}459 candidate repositories { P i } i = 1 M \{P_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} . More details are provided in Appendix B.1 .

paragraphs.en: Program reproduction from scratch requires a prepared runtime sandbox with the necessary toolchains and dependencies so that the agent can focus on rebuilding program functionality. To accommodate differences across repositories, Program-Env pipeline Φ \Phi uses Claude Code as the underlying agent harness and adds an outer loop that validates each proposed build procedure and provides the diagnostics feedback for revision. For each repository P i P_{i} with a standalone executable target, the agent generates download.sh for online dependency preparation and compile.sh for offline compilation. The overall loop proceeds to the next stage only if both scripts succeed and ./executable passes a loadability check. Otherwise, failure diagnostics are returned to the agent for revision. The validated executable serves as B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} , and the prepared image provides the basis for the runtime sandbox 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . Further details are provided in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: Finally, once the build validation succeeds, the dispatcher prepares the resources for black-box test construction. It uses codebase size to determine the number of parallel branches and assigns each branch a functional module. paragraphs.en: Reliable verification is essential for effective supervision in agent training. For program reproduction tasks, a black-box test suite 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} provides this supervision by comparing B ^ i \hat{B}_{i} against B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} on shared inputs. However, tests generated in a single attempt may cover too few behaviors or use assertions that fail to detect incorrect implementations. Program-Env therefore uses structured feedback to guide the agent in iteratively expanding test coverage and strengthening assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的验证对于智能体训练中的有效监督至关重要。 在程序重现任务中，黑盒测试套件 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 通过在对共享输入上比较 B ^ i \hat{B}_{i} 和 B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} 来提供这种监督。 然而，单次尝试中生成的测试可能覆盖的行为过少，或者使用的断言无法检测出错误的实现。 因此，Program-Env 利用结构化反馈引导智能体迭代地扩展测试覆盖范围并加强断言。

paragraphs.en: Following the dispatcher’s module assignments, test construction proceeds in parallel across branches. Each branch runs the Claude Code harness inside an outer loop that validates each delivered suite and returns diagnostics for revision. After each round, the pipeline organizes the feedback into three components, stored as structured documents in Feedback_Docs/ . (i) Summary records what was done and what remains unsolved and why, preserving context across rounds. (ii) Program analysis locates uncovered functionality with dynamic analysis and traces it to public entry points with static analysis. (iii) Validation screens tests through four checks: the pass check identifies tests that fail on B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} ; the double check detects inconsistent outcomes across repeated runs; the dummy check identifies tests that accept a dummy implementation; and the weak-assert check flags insufficient assertions. These checks help identify invalid, unstable, or insufficiently discriminative tests. In the next round, the agent reads these processed documents to repair flagged tests before extending coverage to unexplored targets. A subagent terminates once its module reaches the functionality coverage threshold or the round limit. Once all branches terminate, their suites are merged and validated again, and 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} retains only the tests that pass all checks. Further details are provided in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 遵循调度器的模块分配，测试构建在各分支中并行进行。 每个分支都在外层循环中运行 Claude Code 工具包，以验证每个交付的测试套件，并返回用于修订的诊断信息。 每轮结束后，流程会将反馈整理为三个部分，并以结构化文档的形式存储在 Feedback_Docs/ 目录下。 (i) 摘要记录已完成的工作、尚未解决的问题及其原因，以便在各轮次间保留上下文信息。 (ii) 程序分析通过动态分析定位未覆盖的功能，并通过静态分析将其追溯至公共入口点。 (iii) 验证环节通过四项检查筛选测试：通过检查用于识别在 B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} 上失败的测试；双重检查用于检测重复运行中出现不一致结果的情况；虚拟检查用于识别接受虚拟实现的测试；弱断言检查则标记出断言不足的测试。 这些检查有助于识别无效、不稳定或区分能力不足的测试。 在下一轮中，智能体会读取这些已处理的文档，以修复被标记的测试，然后再将覆盖范围扩展至未探索的目标。 当子智能体的模块达到功能覆盖阈值或轮次限制时，其运行即告终止。 所有分支终止后，它们的测试套件将被合并并再次验证，𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 将仅保留通过所有检查的测试。 更多细节请参见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: In long-horizon program reproduction, single-session workflows may lose early behavioral evidence due to context compression and consequently produce a program that fails to compile ( Anthropic, 2025 ; Hao et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . Inspired by the iterative workflow of software engineers, we propose Program-Agent built on Claude Code to support systematic development in long-horizon program reproduction. As illustrated in Figure 3 , it combines an iterative role-isolated workflow (Section 5.1 ) with a revision management mechanism (Section 5.2 ) for compilation validation and failure recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 在长期程序复现中，单次会话的工作流可能会因上下文压缩而丢失早期的行为证据，从而导致生成的程序无法编译（Anthropic, 2025；Hao et al., 2026；Feng et al., 2026）。 受软件工程师迭代工作流的启发，我们提出了基于 Claude Code 的 Program-Agent，以支持长期程序复现中的系统化开发。 如图 3 所示，该方法将迭代式角色隔离工作流（第 5.1 节）与修订管理机制（第 5.2 节）相结合，用于编译验证和故障恢复。

sents.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , it combines an iterative role-isolated workflow (Section 5.1 ) with a revision management mechanism (Section 5.2 ) for compilation validation and failure recovery.

paragraphs.en: Program-Agent adopts a role-isolated and session-separated iterative paradigm. It decouples program reproduction into two logical roles (analyst and implementer) and three stages: Analysis , Implement , and Review . Each stage executes in an independent session to eliminate cross-stage memory contamination. Handoff artifacts carry behavioral evidence and stage reports across sessions without transferring the full conversation history.
paragraphs.zh: Program-Agent 采用一种角色隔离且会话分离的迭代范式。 它将程序重演解耦为两个逻辑角色（分析师与执行者）和三个阶段：分析、执行与审查。 每个阶段都在独立的会话中执行，以消除跨阶段的记忆污染。 交接产物携带行为证据和阶段报告跨越不同会话，但不会传递完整的对话历史。

paragraphs.en: Given a fixed budget of K K implementation rounds, Program-Agent executes one standardized Analysis stage followed by alternating Implement and Review iterations. This explicit iteration budget resolves two common issues in single-session workflows: premature termination with incomplete implementations, and unbounded low-value exploration that destabilizes long-horizon reproduction.
paragraphs.zh: 在给定 K 个实施轮次的固定预算下，程序智能体会先执行一个标准化的分析阶段，随后交替进行实施与审查迭代。 这种明确的迭代预算解决了单会话工作流程中的两个常见问题：因过早终止而导致的实施不完整，以及无限制的低价值探索对长期复现造成的破坏性影响。

paragraphs.en: Across multiple Implement rounds, the shared Workspace can accumulate error edits until compile.sh no longer produces an executable. Program-Agent therefore treats independent compilation as the gate for each implementation round. It exports a clean snapshot of the committed source and compiles that snapshot outside the development workspace. A snapshot that produces an executable is archived in Revisions and forwarded to the next Review. Moreover, a stage that times out or misses required artifacts or fails this compilation is retried in a fresh session within a bounded budget. If the retry still fails, the implementation rolls back to the last validated revision. A successful revision becomes the recovery checkpoint for later rounds. This keeps progress stable across multi-stage reproduction. More details are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 在多个实现回合中，共享工作区可能会累积错误编辑，直到 compile.sh 不再能生成可执行文件。 因此，程序智能体将独立编译视为每个实现回合的准入条件。 它会导出已提交源代码的纯净快照，并在开发工作区之外对该快照进行编译。 能够生成可执行文件的快照会被归档到“版本”中，并转发至下一轮“评审”。 此外，如果某个阶段出现超时、缺少必要产物或未能通过此编译，则会在限定预算内以全新会话重试。 如果重试仍然失败，实现过程将回滚到最后一个验证成功的版本。 成功通过验证的版本将成为后续回合的恢复检查点。 这确保了在多阶段重现过程中进展的稳定性。 更多细节请参见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: This section presents an evaluation of ProgramGym. Our experiments are designed to answer the following four research questions. RQ1 (Effectiveness of ProgramGym) Does training on Program-Env and solving with Program-Agent improve program reproduction task? RQ2 (Training Environments Analysis) What scale and construction dynamics characterize the environments produced by Program-Env? RQ3 (Test-Time Scaling) Does additional Program-Agent iteration budget improve Tests Passed? RQ4 (Agent Behavior Analysis) How does ProgramGym influence agent behavior on program reproduction tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 本节对 ProgramGym 进行了评估。 我们的实验旨在回答以下四个研究问题。 RQ1（ProgramGym 的有效性）在 Program-Env 上进行训练并使用 Program-Agent 进行求解，是否有助于提升程序复现任务的表现？ RQ2（训练环境分析）由 Program-Env 生成的环境具有怎样的规模和构建动态特征？ RQ3（测试时的扩展性）增加 Program-Agent 的迭代预算是否会导致通过的测试数量增多？ RQ4（智能体行为分析）ProgramGym 如何影响智能体在程序复现任务中的行为？

paragraphs.en: To support interactive program reproduction from scratch, we use Claude Code rather than mini-SWE-agent as the single-session baseline. The task is long-horizon and often exceeds a 256 256 K maximum context window. Claude Code compresses context so the agent can continue, following the ProgramBench protocol of GLM-5.2 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) . We compare it with Program-Agent using the same container resource limits. Program-Agent runs for up to K = 5 K{=}5 iterations. paragraphs.en: To verify the effectiveness of our proposed ProgramGym , we evaluate DS-V4-Flash-0731 , Qwen3.8-27B , and Qwen3.8-27B-SFT on ProgramBench and compare them with frontier models that use mini-SWE-agent (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们提出的 ProgramGym 的有效性，我们在 ProgramBench 上对 DS-V4-Flash-0731、Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.8-27B-SFT 进行了评估，并将其与使用 mini-SWE-agent 的前沿模型进行了比较（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: Program-Env scales verifiable environments for program reproduction from scratch. Holding Claude Code fixed keeps the agent scaffold unchanged and varies only whether the model was trained on Program-Env trajectories. On ProgramBench, Qwen3.8-27B-SFT reaches 42.84% Tests Passed against 34.87% for Qwen3.8-27B ( Δ = + 7.97 \Delta{=}+7.97 ) and narrows the gap to DS-V4-Flash-0731 under the same agent scaffold (57.68%). The Qwen3.8-27B-SFT also exceeds the flagship GPT 5.4 result (37.70%) under mini-SWE-agent . These results indicate that Program-Env’s runtime sandboxes and black-box tests provide reliable behavioral supervision for training on program reproduction tasks.

paragraphs.en: Program-Agent expands a model’s capability boundary for long-horizon program reproduction tasks. Holding the model fixed keeps the weights unchanged and varies only the agent scaffold. Program-Agent raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 55.71% Tests Passed and Qwen3.8-27B-SFT from 42.84% to 56.25% relative to Claude Code . paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose ProgramGym for training agents on long-horizon program reproduction from scratch. Program-Env is a feedback-driven pipeline that builds the reference executable and runtime sandbox and constructs black-box tests from repositories and yields 1,648 1{,}648 training environments in C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87 % 34.87\% to 42.84 % 42.84\% on ProgramBench. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71 % 55.71\% and 56.25 % 56.25\% , both exceeding some flagship models. Extra Program-Agent iterations continue to recover program behavior and Program-Agent rather than SFT alone reshapes the agent toward exploration and revision. We will release ProgramGym as a scalable gym for the community to develop coding agents that discover requirements and design systems from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ProgramGym，用于训练智能体从头开始完成长期程序复现任务。 Program-Env 是一条以反馈为驱动的流水线，它能构建参考可执行文件和运行时沙盒，从代码仓库中生成黑盒测试，并在 C、C++、Go 和 Rust 语言中提供 1,648 个训练环境。 Program-Agent 将分析、实现与评审的隔离式工作流程与修订管理相结合，用于编译检查和故障恢复。 在这些构建好的环境中对轨迹进行微调后，Qwen3.8-27B 在 ProgramBench 上的准确率从 34.87% 提升至 42.84%。 Program-Agent 进一步将基础模型和 SFT 模型的准确率提升至 55.71% 和 56.25%，均超过了部分旗舰模型。 额外的 Program-Agent 迭代能够持续恢复程序行为，而仅使用 Program-Agent 而非单独使用 SFT 的方式，则引导智能体更倾向于探索与修订。 我们将发布 ProgramGym，作为一个可扩展的 Gym 框架，供社区开发能够从零开始发现需求并设计系统的编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: Two factors account for the gap between the 30,459 collected repositories and the 1,648 tasks. (i) Filtering. Many candidates cannot serve as black-box tasks because they fail to build on Linux, require a display or user input devices, or exceed the 3,600-second limit for compilation or instrumentation, which we cannot leave unbounded. Such repositories are excluded before the test construction stage. (ii) Cost. Constructing an environment is expensive, about 82.99M tokens on average (Appendix B.5 ), so processing the full candidate pool was beyond our budget. The pipeline itself, however, is fully automated, so that the community can construct further high-quality environments from the remaining repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 已收集的 30,459 个仓库与 1,648 项任务之间存在差距，这由两个因素造成：(i) 筛选。 许多候选项无法作为黑箱任务使用，因为它们无法在 Linux 上构建、需要显示设备或用户输入设备，或者超过了编译或插桩的 3,600 秒限制，而这一限制我们无法不设上限。 此类仓库在测试构建阶段之前就被排除在外。(ii) 成本。 构建一个环境成本高昂，平均约需 82.99M 个令牌（附录 B.5），因此处理完整的候选池超出了我们的预算。 然而，该流程本身是完全自动化的，因此社区可以从剩余的仓库中构建更多高质量的环境。

paragraphs.en: Under the complexity score ξ \xi of Section B.3.1 , the 1,648 tasks split into 1,492 easy, 151 medium, and 5 hard. This skew is intentional. (i) ξ \xi measures repository size rather than the difficulty of program reproduction from scratch: a large codebase may expose few black-box entry points and little observable behavior. (ii) Tasks far beyond current model capability yield almost no successful trajectories, so collecting more of them adds little effective training signal. (iii) Despite the skew, models trained on Program-Env show clear gains in program reproduction ability (Section 6 ). As model capability grows, the same pipeline can be scaled to medium and hard repositories to push the frontier of coding models further.
paragraphs.zh: 在 B.3.1 节的复杂度得分 ξ \xi 下，1,648 个任务被分为 1,492 个简单任务、151 个中等难度任务和 5 个困难任务。 这种分布不均是有意的。 (i) ξ \xi 衡量的是代码库的大小，而非从头复现程序的难度：一个大型代码库可能仅有少数黑盒入口点和极少的可观察行为。 (ii) 远超当前模型能力的任务几乎不会产生成功轨迹，因此收集更多这类任务对有效训练信号的贡献微乎其微。 (iii) 尽管存在这种分布不均，但在 Program-Env 上训练的模型在程序复现能力方面仍表现出显著提升（第 6 节）。 随着模型能力的提升，相同的流程可扩展至中等难度和困难程度的代码库，从而进一步拓展编码模型的边界。

paragraphs.en: We could not report a mean coverage curve over iterations for two reasons. (i) Subagents terminate at different rounds , whether by reaching the coverage threshold, the round limit, or early stopping (Appendix B.4.3 ), so averaging over surviving modules would be biased toward the hardest ones and understate the gain from feedback. (ii) Coverage is only aggregated to the repository level after all branches terminate , so no repository-level curve over iterations exists. We therefore present case studies instead. The two cases in Figure 12 were chosen to represent the two effects of feedback, repairing weak tests and expanding functionality coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们未能针对迭代过程报告平均覆盖曲线，原因有二。 (i) 子智能体在不同轮次中终止，无论是达到覆盖阈值、轮次限制还是提前停止（附录 B.4.3），因此对存活的模块进行平均会偏向于那些难度最大的模块，并低估反馈带来的增益。 (ii) 所有分支终止后，覆盖度才汇总到仓库级别，因此不存在跨迭代的仓库级别曲线。 因此，我们转而呈现案例研究。 图 12 中的两个案例被选中，用以体现反馈的两个效应：修复弱测试和扩展功能覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: This restriction follows the separation of responsibilities in software engineering: Analysis extracts behavioral requirements, Implement produces a buildable source revision from Handoff artifacts, and Review independently identifies remaining discrepancies. If the Implement stage could access the reference program, the agent might continue probing and matching marginal edge cases after completing its primary objectives, delaying delivery and degrading the staged workflow into open-ended trial and error. Program-Agent instead delegates further behavioral exploration to Review, which converts verified discrepancies into explicit requirements for the next round. This design preserves clear stage boundaries while ensuring steady and auditable progress.
paragraphs.zh: 这一限制遵循了软件工程中的职责分离原则：分析阶段提取行为需求，实现阶段基于交接产物生成可构建的源代码版本，而审查阶段则独立识别出其余差异。 如果实现阶段能够访问参考程序，智能体在完成主要目标后可能会持续探测和匹配边缘情况，从而延迟交付，并使分阶段工作流程退化为无终止的试错过程。 相比之下，“程序-智能体”模式将进一步的行为探索委托给审查阶段，由审查阶段将已验证的差异转化为下一轮所需的明确需求。 这种设计既保持了各阶段之间的清晰界限，又确保了进展的持续性和可审计性。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , Program-Env is constructed through a multi-stage pipeline, and this section provides the implementation details of each stage. Section B.2 then explains how each repository is built into a validated executable B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} and runtime sandbox 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe our four-stage pipeline for systematically collecting and filtering open-source repositories from GitHub. The pipeline consists of Comprehensive Search, Metadata Validation, Commit Locking, and Build Config Detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍我们用于从 GitHub 上系统性地收集和筛选开源仓库的四阶段流程。 该流程包括全面搜索、元数据验证、提交锁定以及构建配置检测四个步骤。

sents.en: In this section, we describe our four-stage pipeline for systematically collecting and filtering open-source repositories from GitHub.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍我们用于从 GitHub 上系统性地收集和筛选开源仓库的四阶段流程。

sents.en: The pipeline consists of Comprehensive Search, Metadata Validation, Commit Locking, and Build Config Detection.
sents.zh: 该流程包括全面搜索、元数据验证、提交锁定以及构建配置检测四个步骤。

paragraphs.en: For the corpus analyzed in this work, we search for repositories with C, C++, Go, or Rust as their primary language. Repository retrieval is conducted via the GitHub Search API. To circumvent its 1000-result limitation per query, we partition the search space independently for each language using six mutually exclusive star-count buckets: [ 200,499 ] [200,499] , [ 500,999 ] [500,999] , [ 1,000 , 1 , 999 ] [1{,}000,1{,}999] , [ 2,000 , 9 , 999 ] [2{,}000,9{,}999] , [ 10,000 , 49 , 999 ] [10{,}000,49{,}999] , and [ 50,000 , ∞ ) [50{,}000,\infty) . If a query exceeds this limit, its star-count bucket is recursively bisected until the sub-query yields fewer than 1,000 results, the bucket can no longer be divided, or the maximum recursion depth of 12 is reached. For the open-ended highest bucket, the maximum star count observed in the returned results is used as a temporary upper bound for computing the bisection midpoint, while the resulting upper sub-query remains open-ended. This search strategy stratifies repositories by programming language and star count, improving repository coverage within the constraints of the GitHub Search API. Additionally, we include fork:false and archived:false in every query to reduce duplicate and inactive repositories in the candidate pool.
paragraphs.zh: 对于本研究分析的语料库，我们搜索以 C、C++、Go 或 Rust 为主要编程语言的仓库。 仓库的检索通过 GitHub 搜索 API 进行。 为避免每次查询受限于最多返回 1000 条结果，我们对每种语言独立划分搜索空间，使用六个互斥的星标数量区间：[ 200,499 ] [200,499]、[ 500,999 ] [500,999]、[ 1,000 , 1 , 999 ] [1{,}000,1{,}999]、[ 2,000 , 9 , 999 ] [2{,}000,9{,}999]、[ 10,000 , 49 , 999 ] [10{,}000,49{,}999] 以及 [ 50,000 , ∞ ) [50{,}000,\infty) 。 如果某次查询超出此限制，则递归地将对应的星标数量区间对半划分，直到子查询返回的结果少于 1000 条、该区间无法进一步划分，或达到最大递归深度 12。 对于最高且范围开放的区间，使用返回结果中观察到的最大星标数量作为计算二分中点的临时上限，而由此产生的较高子查询仍保持开放范围。 这种搜索策略按编程语言和星标数量对仓库进行分层，从而在 GitHub 搜索 API 的限制下提升了仓库的覆盖范围。 此外，我们在每次查询中都加入 fork:false 和 archived:false，以减少候选池中的重复仓库和非活跃仓库。

paragraphs.en: We locally re-validate the retrieved repository metadata to ensure consistency with the search criteria. Specifically, we check each repository’s primary language and star count, remove duplicate repositories based on full_name , and require a non-empty SPDX license identifier as a basic metadata completeness criterion. We further exclude repositories already used by existing code-related benchmarks, thereby preventing repository-level overlap with prior evaluation sets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对检索到的仓库元数据进行本地重新验证，以确保其与搜索标准保持一致。 具体而言，我们会检查每个仓库的主要语言和星标数量，根据 full_name 移除重复的仓库，并要求 SPDX 许可证标识符非空，以此作为元数据完整性的基本标准。 此外，我们还会排除已被现有代码相关基准测试使用的仓库，从而避免与先前评估集在仓库层面出现重叠。

paragraphs.en: Because GitHub repositories are continuously updated, we fix a specific code version for each qualified repository—specifically, the latest commit (i.e., the branch tip) of the default branch at the moment of data retrieval. Ultimately, exactly one commit is retained for each repository.

paragraphs.en: After commit locking, we perform a lightweight, static detection of the selected commit to identify repositories with explicit build-configuration evidence. For each repository, we resolve the root tree of the selected commit and retrieve its recursive file tree through the GitHub REST API. We then search both the repository root and its subdirectories for common build-configuration markers relevant to target languages, including Cargo.toml for Rust, go.mod for Go, and native build-system files such as CMakeLists.txt , Makefile , and meson.build for C and C++. We additionally treat npm-related configuration, such as package.json , as auxiliary evidence of build infrastructure. A repository passes this stage if at least one recognized marker is found anywhere in its retrieved file tree; otherwise, it is excluded. This procedure serves only as a scalable proxy for the presence of build infrastructure and does not establish that a repository can be successfully compiled.
paragraphs.zh: 在完成提交锁定后，我们对选定的提交执行轻量级的静态检测，以识别包含明确构建配置证据的仓库。 对于每个仓库，我们解析选定提交的根树，并通过 GitHub REST API 获取其递归文件树。 接着，我们在仓库根目录及其子目录中搜索与目标语言相关的常见构建配置标记，包括 Rust 的 Cargo.toml、Go 的 go.mod，以及 C 和 C++ 的原生构建系统文件（如 CMakeLists.txt、Makefile 和 meson.build）。 此外，我们将 npm 相关的配置（如 package.json）视为构建基础设施的辅助证据。 如果在检索到的文件树中任何位置发现至少一个已识别的标记，则该仓库通过此阶段；否则将被排除。 此过程仅作为构建基础设施存在与否的可扩展代理，并不能证明仓库能够成功编译。

paragraphs.en: Building a project requires a compiler, standard library, and build tools that match the project itself, and installing the latest version of each does not guarantee a successful build. As Table 4 shows, the reasons a language breaks under its newest toolchain differ case by case. The build environment must therefore be prepared according to each project’s actual version requirements rather than fixed per language.

paragraphs.en: To accommodate these differences, Program-Env equips the build agent with a skill for each supported language that encodes how to resolve toolchain versions, obtain dependencies, and drive the build. Guided by the skill, the agent makes environment preparation explicit in a script download.sh , which fetches and configures the required compiler, build tools, and third-party dependencies and exports the environment variables used by the subsequent build. A second script, compile.sh , then builds the gold executable program B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star} within the prepared environment. The separation reflects the solving side, in which the source is reconstructed from interaction with the executable under no network access. Compiling offline verifies that the prepared environment is self-contained, sparing the solving model from generating missing dependencies or compilers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了适应这些差异，Program-Env 为构建智能体配备了每种支持语言的技能，这些技能编码了如何解析工具链版本、获取依赖项以及驱动构建过程。 在技能的指导下，该智能体通过脚本 download.sh 显式完成环境准备：该脚本会下载并配置所需的编译器、构建工具和第三方依赖项，同时导出后续构建过程中使用的环境变量。 随后，第二个脚本 compile.sh 会在已准备好的环境中构建黄金可执行程序 B i ⋆ B_{i}^{\star}。 这种分离体现了求解环节：在没有网络访问的情况下，通过与可执行程序的交互来重构源代码。 离线编译验证了准备的环境是自包含的，从而避免了求解模型需要生成缺失的依赖项或编译器。

paragraphs.en: Validation combines a static linter with two-stage execution. The linter, shown in Table 5 , first ensures that the generated scripts do not mask failures, since a hidden error leaves nothing for the build agent to diagnose. It rejects || true , redirections that discard standard error, and placeholder content, and requires acceptable failures to be handled by explicit conditional branches. The checks are intentionally strict, as a false positive costs a single repair round while an undetected failure propagates to every downstream stage.
paragraphs.zh: 验证将静态代码检查器与两阶段执行相结合。 如表 5 所示，代码检查器首先确保生成的脚本不会掩盖故障，因为隐藏的错误会导致构建智能体无法诊断任何问题。 它会拒绝 || true、丢弃标准错误的重定向以及占位符内容，并要求通过显式的条件分支来处理可接受的故障。 这些检查是有意设计得非常严格的，因为一次误报只会浪费一个修复周期，而未检测到的故障则会蔓延到所有下游阶段。

paragraphs.en: Execution then proceeds online and offline. The system first runs download.sh in a container with network access, providing the script alone and not providing the project source, so that the script must generate its own dependency manifest for prefetching. Upon success, the system records the exported environment variables and a snapshot of installed packages, and freezes the container state as the runtime sandbox 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . The system then places the project source in a separate working directory, launches a network-disabled container from 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} , restores the recorded environment variables, and executes compile.sh . Since the build cannot reach the network, it succeeds only if the toolchain and local resources prepared in the first stage are sufficient. Validation checks the exit status of both scripts, the presence of an executable at the agreed location, and the format and linkage of that executable. As shown in Figure 2 , the linkage check runs ldd on the B i ∗ B_{i}^{*} to confirm that it was built successfully and no dynamic library is missing.
paragraphs.zh: 执行过程随后在线上和线下进行。 系统首先在具有网络访问权限的容器中运行 download.sh，仅提供脚本本身而不提供项目源代码，因此该脚本必须自行生成依赖项清单以进行预取。 成功后，系统会记录导出的环境变量和已安装包的快照，并将容器状态冻结为运行时沙盒 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i}。 随后，系统将项目源代码放入一个独立的工作目录，从 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} 启动一个禁用网络的容器，恢复记录的环境变量，并执行 compile.sh。 由于构建过程无法访问网络，因此只有当第一阶段准备好的工具链和本地资源足够时，构建才能成功。 验证环节会检查两个脚本的退出状态、约定位置处是否存在可执行文件，以及该可执行文件的格式和链接情况。 如图 2 所示，链接检查通过运行 ldd 命令作用于 B i ∗ B_{i}^{*}，以确认其已成功构建且没有动态库缺失。

paragraphs.en: Our validation is deliberately strict to guarantee the stability of downstream stages, and current agents do not reliably satisfy every constraint in a single attempt (Figure 9 ). The pipeline therefore carries each failure forward as structured feedback for the next attempt, comprising the previous download.sh and compile.sh , the diagnosis, and a suggested fix. A linter finding is reported with its triggered rule, location, and offending snippet, whereas an execution failure is reported with its error output and the relevant log excerpt. Both are accompanied by a suggested fix (Table 6 ). The agent is required to read this feedback before editing the scripts, so that known failures are not repeated. paragraphs.en: Figure 10 illustrates a repair guided by such feedback. In the first attempt, download.sh installs libopenimageio-dev but not the OpenEXR development package, so the offline build fails when CMake cannot locate OpenEXRConfig.cmake . The feedback packages the two scripts, the error log, and the remediation instruction to install the missing dependency in download.sh . The revised scripts then pass online preparation, offline compilation, and the dynamic linking check.

paragraphs.en: To provide execution feedback to test generation, the dispatcher equips the target program with coverage collection, yielding the instrumented program. Rule-based instrumentation is the natural first choice, as it is deterministic and incurs no model cost. Build systems, however, vary considerably across repositories in their entry points, in how compiler flags are propagated, and in how source files map to build artifacts. A language-specific rule therefore captures the common instrumentation path of its language but not the build behavior peculiar to each repository, and even determining whether a rule applies to a given repository is nontrivial. Moreover, injecting instrumentation flags indiscriminately may corrupt the build by conflicting with existing compiler or linker settings (Table 8 , last column). We therefore adopt a rule-first, agent-fallback strategy. The language-specific rule first constructs an instrumentation candidate, which an independent validator then checks for the presence of build artifacts and coverage metadata. Only upon validation failure does the system fall back to an instrumentation agent, an LLM agent that diagnoses and repairs the instrumentation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在执行时提供反馈以测试生成效果，调度器为目标程序配备了覆盖收集功能，从而得到经过插装的程序。 基于规则的插装是自然的优先选择，因为它是确定性的且不会产生模型成本。 然而，构建系统在入口点、编译器标志的传播方式以及源文件与构建产物之间的映射关系上，因仓库而异，差异显著。 因此，特定语言的规则虽然能捕捉该语言通用的插装路径，却无法涵盖每个仓库特有的构建行为；甚至判断某条规则是否适用于某个特定仓库也并非易事。 此外，不加区分地注入插装标志可能会与现有的编译器或链接器设置发生冲突，从而破坏构建过程（表8，最后一列）。 因此，我们采用“优先使用规则、智能体作为备用”的策略。 特定语言的规则首先构建一个插装候选方案，随后由独立的验证器检查其中是否存在构建产物和覆盖元数据。 只有在验证失败时，系统才会转而使用插装智能体——一个能够诊断并修复插装问题的 LLM 智能体。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 11 , the dispatcher’s fourth component, Docs Extraction , employs an LLM agent to select two categories of content from the validated repository and place them into the documentation D i D_{i} of the constructed environment. The first category is repository documents, namely the README and LICENSE. The second is test input assets that a model cannot reasonably synthesize on its own, such as images and domain-specific binary formats, together with the minimal runtime dependencies they require. paragraphs.en: After each round, the four checks of Section B.4.1 write their findings to validation.json . Rather than raw pytest output, each finding is reported as an actionable item with the test or script location, issue category, severity, diagnostics, and a suggested fix, so that the agent knows not only what failed but also how to correct it. Repair precedes authoring for two reasons. First, repairing an existing test is far cheaper than writing a new one, since the location and fix are already identified and the change is typically local. Second, newly written tests may introduce further issues, and without timely repair these defects accumulate across rounds. Repairing first keeps every retained test stable and effective, so that coverage grows on a reliable foundation.

paragraphs.en: An uncovered location alone does not indicate which input to construct, particularly when the target function sits deep in a call hierarchy. Program-Env builds on mature static analysis tools rather than custom analyzers. Joern provides code property graphs (CPG) ( Yamaguchi et al., 2014 ) , call graphs, control flow, and data flow for all supported languages except Rust, for which CodeQL is used instead. Because these tools expose standard interfaces, the analysis layer is pluggable, and a backend can be replaced or a new analysis added without changing the rest of the pipeline. The databases produced by Joern and CodeQL span the entire program and are far too large to hand to the agent. Program-Env therefore queries them only for the uncovered targets in coverage_targets.json , which is why static analysis starts from the second round, after the first coverage measurement. For each target, the pipeline maps its uncovered lines to the enclosing functions, traverses the call graph in reverse to find public entries through which a black-box test can reach them, and gathers the control-flow and data-flow context of those functions. The results are written to feedback_docs/ . Beyond the pre-computed artifacts, the Joern and CodeQL databases remain queryable inside 𝒮 i test \mathcal{S}_{i}^{\mathrm{test}} , and the agent is encouraged to issue its own queries while writing tests.

sents.zh: Joern 为所有受支持的语言提供代码属性图（CPG）（Yamaguchi 等人，2014）、调用图、控制流和数据流，但 Rust 除外，Rust 则改用 CodeQL。

sents.en: Because these tools expose standard interfaces, the analysis layer is pluggable, and a backend can be replaced or a new analysis added without changing the rest of the pipeline.
sents.zh: 由于这些工具提供了标准接口，分析层具有可插拔性，因此无需更改流程的其他部分，即可替换后端或添加新的分析功能。

sents.en: The databases produced by Joern and CodeQL span the entire program and are far too large to hand to the agent.
sents.zh: Joern 和 CodeQL 生成的数据库涵盖了整个程序，其规模过大，无法直接交给智能体处理。

sents.en: Program-Env therefore queries them only for the uncovered targets in coverage_targets.json , which is why static analysis starts from the second round, after the first coverage measurement.
sents.zh: 因此，Program-Env 仅针对 coverage_targets.json 中列出的未覆盖目标进行查询，这也是静态分析从第二轮开始，在第一轮覆盖率测量之后执行的原因。

sents.en: For each target, the pipeline maps its uncovered lines to the enclosing functions, traverses the call graph in reverse to find public entries through which a black-box test can reach them, and gathers the control-flow and data-flow context of those functions.
sents.zh: 对于每个目标，该流程会将其未覆盖的行映射到包含这些行的函数，反向遍历调用图以找到黑盒测试可以触及这些函数的公共入口，并收集这些函数的控制流和数据流上下文。

sents.en: The results are written to feedback_docs/ .
sents.zh: 结果将写入 feedback_docs/ 目录。

sents.en: Beyond the pre-computed artifacts, the Joern and CodeQL databases remain queryable inside 𝒮 i test \mathcal{S}_{i}^{\mathrm{test}} , and the agent is encouraged to issue its own queries while writing tests.
sents.zh: 除了预计算的产物外，Joern 和 CodeQL 数据库在 𝒮 i test \mathcal{S}_{i}^{\mathrm{test}} 内部仍然支持查询，并且鼓励智能体在编写测试时自行发起查询。

paragraphs.en: The feedback above describes only the current round, while the agent’s context is not preserved across rounds. To serve as memory between rounds, the agent writes summary.md at the end of each round, recording what it did, which targets it addressed or skipped and why, and which targets are left for the next round. The next round reads this summary before acting, so that it continues from the previous state rather than starting from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 上述反馈仅描述了当前回合的情况，而智能体的上下文信息并未在回合之间保留。 为了在回合之间充当记忆，智能体在每个回合结束时都会编写 summary.md，记录其执行的操作、处理或跳过哪些目标及其原因，以及哪些目标留待下一回合处理。 下一回合在执行操作前会读取这份摘要，从而从之前的状态继续执行，而不是从头开始。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 illustrates both kinds of guidance on COLMAP. The first case shows dynamic analysis. All tests pass yet module coverage is only 29.92%. Coverage feedback singles out ply.cc with 375 missing lines, and the agent finds that one .ply input through mesh_simplifier reaches most of them, lifting the file to 80.03% and the module to 42.86%. The second case shows static analysis. The agent had skipped AverageUnitVectors , assuming it was reachable only through a full structure-from-motion run and dismissing that path as too heavy. The call graph reveals a lightweight path through the standalone rotation_averaging command that reaches the target left uncovered in the previous round, and following it raises module coverage from 36.41% to 45.47%. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 17 , building the 1,648 tasks consumed 136.77B tokens in total, the vast majority on writing tests. Of the final 665,512 test cases, 655,559 (98.50%) are written from scratch by the pipeline against source functionality, and only 9,953 (1.50%) are rewritten from the repository’s native tests. Even among the 272 repositories that ship a native test suite, reused tests account for a median of 2.8% of the final suite (Figure 16 ), so the verifiability of each environment comes from the pipeline rather than from upstream tests. Static program analysis costs 11.74 hours in total (Table 14 ), yet scanning a single repository takes only 25.64 seconds on average.

paragraphs.en: When Analysis or Review fails validation, its stage directory is deleted before the next attempt. paragraphs.en: We fine-tune Qwen3.8-27B on trajectories collected from Program-Env for two epochs using ms-swift ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . We issue task-level rollout requests for all 1,648 Program-Env tasks. Because Claude Code resets or switches its conversation context during a rollout, a single task-level rollout can yield multiple interaction segments with separate contexts. We treat each such segment as a separate training trajectory for supervised fine-tuning, yielding 64,505 training trajectories in total. Thus, the trajectory count does not correspond to 64,505 independent environment rollouts. All model parameters are updated during fine-tuning. Table 17 summarizes the main training settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ms-swift（Zhao 等人，2024）在从 Program-Env 收集到的轨迹上对 Qwen3.8-27B 进行了两个周期的微调。 我们针对所有 1,648 个 Program-Env 任务发起了任务级的展开请求。 由于 Claude Code 在展开过程中会重置或切换对话上下文，单个任务级的展开可能会产生多个具有独立上下文的交互片段。 我们将每个这样的片段视为监督微调中的一个独立训练轨迹，最终共得到 64,505 条训练轨迹。 因此，轨迹数量并不对应于 64,505 次独立的环境展开。 在微调过程中，所有模型参数都会被更新。 表 17 总结了主要的训练设置。

sents.en: Table 17 summarizes the main training settings.
sents.zh: 表 17 总结了主要的训练设置。

paragraphs.en: We pack training sequences into blocks of up to 262,144 tokens to accommodate long interaction trajectories. Examples exceeding the maximum sequence length are discarded. We compute the training loss only over eligible model-generated assistant tokens, while user inputs, environment feedback, and tool observations are used as conditioning context and excluded from the loss. Within assistant outputs, we additionally set the loss mask to zero for assistant turns that invoke tools unavailable in the corresponding environment. These invalid tool-use actions therefore do not contribute to the training objective, while the remaining valid turns from the same trajectory are retained. Training uses BF16 precision with full activation recomputation to reduce memory usage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将训练序列打包为最多包含 262,144 个标记的块，以支持较长的交互轨迹。 超过最大序列长度的示例将被丢弃。 我们仅对模型生成的有效助手标记计算训练损失，而用户输入、环境反馈和工具观察则用作条件上下文，并排除在损失计算之外。 在助手输出中，对于调用对应环境中不可用工具的助手回合，我们还将损失掩码设为零。 因此，这些无效的工具使用操作不会对训练目标产生贡献，而同一轨迹中其余有效的回合仍会被保留。 训练采用 BF16 精度，并通过完全重计算激活值来减少内存占用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 21 shows that Program-Agent improves not just average results, but also how test pass rates are distributed across different tasks. When using Qwen3.8-27B , it increases the share of tasks that pass at least 50% of tests from 40.5% to 62.0%, and raises the share passing at least 75% of tests from 18.0% to 34.0%. With Qwen3.8-27B-SFT , the corresponding gains are from 43.5% to 62.0% and from 9.5% to 29.5%. The two Program-Agent curves stay close over most of the threshold range. This tells us its structured workflow with separate roles delivers more steady benefits, compared to simply switching between these two model versions. On the other hand, the effect of SFT changes depending on which test threshold we look at. SFT helps more tasks reach partial working functionality, but it cannot reliably boost the high-fidelity cases at the upper end of the distribution. The slow falling shape of all four curves also shows that tasks vary widely in difficulty. Meanwhile, the upward shift caused by Program-Agent demonstrates that this iterative development method works well across a wider range of task difficulty levels.
paragraphs.zh: 图21显示，Program-Agent不仅提升了平均结果，还改善了测试通过率在不同任务中的分布情况。 使用Qwen3.8-27B时，至少通过50%测试的任务比例从40.5%提升至62.0%，而至少通过75%测试的任务比例则从18.0%提升至34.0%。 使用Qwen3.8-27B-SFT时，对应的提升幅度分别为从43.5%到62.0%，以及从9.5%到29.5%。 在大多数阈值范围内，两条Program-Agent曲线始终保持接近。 这表明，与其简单地在两种模型版本之间切换，采用具有明确角色分工的结构化工作流程能带来更稳定的收益。 另一方面，SFT的效果会因所考察的测试阈值不同而有所差异。 SFT能帮助更多任务达到部分功能可用的状态，但无法可靠地提升分布顶端的高保真案例表现。 四条曲线均呈现缓慢下降的趋势，这也说明各项任务在难度上存在显著差异。 同时，Program-Agent带来的向上偏移表明，这种迭代开发方法在更广泛的任务难度范围内都能有效发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: To compare implementations that have roughly the same functions, we limit our code-size analysis to solutions that pass at least 75% of the behavior tests. This gives us 182 test runs covering 93 tasks and four different model–agent setups. As shown in Figure 22 , these generated solutions have a median of 1,881 lines of code, while the matching reference implementations have 2,596 lines. In total, 67.6% of the test runs sit below the y = x y=x parity line, and the median ratio of model-generated code lines to reference code lines is 0.64. The implementations that exceed parity mostly come from smaller projects: their reference code has a median of 969 lines, while cases below parity have reference code with a median of 4,303 lines. This pattern tied to project size shows that small tasks are more impacted by fixed setup code and extra compatibility code. For large tasks, by contrast, agents can often recreate the required features just by coding the behavior visible through program interfaces and tests.

paragraphs.en: Figure 23 shows that the median code size for all four configurations stays below the parity level, but their distributions are quite different. When using Qwen3.8-27B , Program-Agent increases the median LoC ratio from 0.58 to 0.75, and when using Qwen3.8-27B-SFT , it raises the ratio from 0.49 to 0.67. Its upper quartile values also hit 1.53 and 1.36. By comparison, the matching Claude Code configurations only reach 1.01 and 0.75. This means Program-Agent achieves better functional performance not just by producing shorter code uniformly. Its iterative process often builds more complete and detailed implementations, and sometimes the generated code becomes larger than the reference version. When combined with the test-pass distributions shown in Figure 21 , this finding indicates the extra code comes from repeated tries to handle behaviors that the first version of code fails to cover. Still, how large these final solutions end up varies a lot between different tasks.

paragraphs.en: Figure 24 shows a clear trend that changes with programming language. C/C++ tasks have the lowest median ratio of 0.39, and only 13.3% of the generated implementations meet or exceed the reference code size. Go falls in the middle with a median ratio of 0.55, while Rust is closest to the reference code size, with a median ratio of 0.72 and 35.5% of generated solutions meeting or exceeding the reference size. One reasonable explanation is that agents can often recreate the functions of C/C++ utilities using more concise abstract code, without rebuilding all the low-level underlying code present in fully developed reference projects. On the other hand, Rust tasks are more commonly reimplemented using Rust code with a similar structure, so the new code keeps much of the verbosity seen in the original reference code. The long upper tails for Go and Rust in the figure also tell us that some tasks require large amounts of extra code to handle compatibility or embed behavioral data, which makes the rebuilt implementation far longer than the original reference code.
